children: Kunal raval takes charge of corporate finance at jsw steel after more than nine years across finance and project finance roles

Kunal Raval has been elevated to Vice President – Corporate Finance at JSW Steel, taking on a broader finance leadership role after more than nine years with the company. His new responsibilities include corporate finance and strategic financial initiatives.

Raval takes charge as Vice President after serving as Associate Vice President at JSW Steel from August 2023 to September 2026. He moves into the role in October 2026 and continues to be based in Mumbai.

His elevation adds to his experience across corporate and project finance functions within the steel company. Before becoming Associate Vice President, Raval served as General Manager – Finance from October 2021 to July 2023.
In that role, his responsibilities included project and corporate finance functions.

Raval has held several finance positions at JSW Steel since joining the company in March 2017. He started as Assistant General Manager and later moved into the role of Deputy General Manager in February 2021.
He subsequently became General Manager – Finance in October 2021 before being elevated to Associate Vice President in August 2023.
His progression within the organisation has covered project finance, corporate finance and broader financial responsibilities.
Before joining JSW Steel, Raval spent more than seven years with SBI Capital Markets. He served as Assistant Vice President from October 2009 to March 2017.
His earlier experience in capital markets, followed by finance roles at JSW Steel, has given him exposure to both financing and corporate finance functions.
Raval is a Chartered Accountant and is associated with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.

In his new position, Raval will focus on corporate finance and strategic financial initiatives at JSW Steel. The appointment marks another step in his progression through the company’s finance function.
His new mandate builds on his experience in project finance, corporate finance and capital markets accumulated across his career.
